summary: PicoCELA Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its extraordinary general meeting of shareholders held on April 30, 2026. Shareholders approved a partial amendment to the articles of incorporation, issuance of Class A preferred shares by third-party allotment at $1.25 per share (with expenses deducted), and election of two directors. The meeting is a routine governance event under Japan's Companies Act and does not constitute a special situation under US event-driven classifications.
